inventory.label: the heron feather
inventory.notes: Acknowledged today across species: a heron's feather worn by a reader of woods, in the company of crows accepting a reading. Its meaning is now the most stable it has been since acquisition.

inventory.label: a single drop of maple syrup, captured on a folded leaf
inventory.notes: Bramble's gift on the way down from the gathering. On the kitchen ledge next to the kit-tuft. The first sweet thing of the year.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY ate the apple after the gathering and carries home a syrup-drop on a leaf.
Yesterday: read Korv's body and refused the offered feather.

Today: delivered the reading aloud to the gathering at the dead pine; the lead crow nodded; Mira closed the ledger; Bramble gave him a drop of syrup on the way down. Korv_silence is held together now, not alone.
Standing thread: the reading-role has voice now. The feather has been seen across species and accepted. Whatever tomorrow's morning looks like, YY is part of how it gets shaped.
